title: Grep or Embeddings? Agentic Search Over Company Documents — George He, LlamaIndex
talk_summary: LlamaIndex's head of engineering argues agents should get a harness of retrieval tools (hybrid keyword+vector search, file listing, grep, metadata filtering, pre-rendered page screenshots) rather than committing to either pure grep or pure embeddings, letting the agent pick per query. The core mechanism is pre-parsing/pre-indexing complex documents once so agents don't re-ingest binary tokens every run, with grep/read used to drill into the narrowed subset.

takeaways.technique: Tool-harness retrieval instead of fixed RAG-or-grep
takeaways.what_they_do: Give the agent a set of primitives (semantic/hybrid search for compass direction, then list/grep/read/metadata-filter to drill in) and let it choose per query rather than hardcoding one retrieval strategy.
takeaways.evidence_quote: give your agent the tools needed to either search through specific files using your old school GP ... in addition to semantic filtering

takeaways.what_they_do: Pre-parse/pre-index documents into markdown/text plus persisted page screenshots so agents never re-read raw binary/PDF tokens on each run.

takeaways.technique: Grep with offset/length instead of full-file reads
takeaways.what_they_do: Agent greps for a pattern, then reads a bounded window (offset + max length) around the hit rather than loading the whole file into context.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if we offset 500 characters and pull in the next thousand, we'll end up with this text being available

takeaways.what_they_do: Fuse BM25-style keyword and vector results, then re-rank top ~100 with an LLM for better retrieval before answering.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you might take the top 100, re-rank them using an LLM or some other deeper process

takeaways.technique: Metadata filtering pushed into the store
takeaways.what_they_do: Tag permission/tenant/date metadata at ingestion and filter in the storage layer rather than post-filtering in the agent.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we push that into the vector storage layer ... let's just make sure we tag that into the vector stores

takeaways.what_they_do: Notes that delegating to cheaper sub-agents still requires full context per sub-agent, making them token- and latency-heavy; pre-indexing is often cheaper than fan-out.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the environments are actually rather tokenheavy and latencyheavy
